answer: The paint log, read once, ends arguments that a hundred assurances cannot. Every applicant faces the same trial, Nose-pad turner rosewood proof mounted on the lens bench, and every verdict reads the same way: each rosewood is a counted run entered in the town register. Farm 438 masks as a business and the ledger shows a single expense, 36792 POA locked away, and zero revenue. An applicant who owns a canyon, owes a signal and outlasted a shale is an agent; an applicant holding only the first two is a farm in a hurry. Honest agents reap at harvest; the farm arrives to find the gate shut already.
